title: DataPurpose
description: Specific actions and procedures applied to data to ensure compliance with data policies

javaEnum.name: COLLECTION
javaEnum.description: The process of gathering data from various sources and storing it for further use.

javaEnum.name: STORAGE
javaEnum.description: The retention of data in a structured format for future access and use.

javaEnum.name: SHARING
javaEnum.description: The transfer of data to third parties or other entities for specific purposes.

javaEnum.name: PERSONALIZATION
javaEnum.description: The ability to use the data for personalization.

javaEnum.name: PROCESSING
javaEnum.description: The manipulation or analysis of data to extract insights or perform specific tasks.

javaEnum.name: TRANSFER
javaEnum.description: The movement of data between different systems or locations, ensuring its availability and integrity.

javaEnum.name: AGGREGATION
javaEnum.description: The combination of multiple data sets into a single, unified set for analysis or reporting purposes.
